name: Regex Explainer
summary: Paste a JavaScript regular expression and get a static, token-by-token explanation — no AI.
description: Break a regex into tokens (literals, escapes, classes, groups, lookarounds, quantifiers, anchors) with plain-language explanations from static rules. Click any token to inspect it. Validates syntax with the browser’s RegExp engine and never uploads your pattern.

faqs.question: Is this AI-generated?
faqs.answer: No. Explanations come from a fixed rule table and tokenizer for the JavaScript (ECMAScript) flavor.

faqs.question: Which regex flavor?
faqs.answer: JavaScript / ECMAScript — the same engine as Forge’s Regex Tester and your browser.

faqs.question: What if my pattern is invalid?
faqs.answer: You’ll see the engine’s syntax error. The tool still tries to show a partial token breakdown when possible.
